name: Archetype-Guided Persona Sampling Pool
description: This file defines persona archetypes for ReMem-RE. It is not a fixed list of final users. Each archetype defines a common life situation and allowable value ranges. A concrete persona instance should be generated by sampling within one archetype and then passing basic consistency checks.
design_goals: Support ordinary-life, public-facing, non-autobiographical persona generation.
Cover diverse occupations, family structures, life stages, and stress patterns.
Keep personas plausible enough for persistent event-line construction.
Avoid over-concentration around researcher / young child / paper deadline / spouse coordination trajectories.

do_not_generate: race or ethnicity unless explicitly required by a study design

sensitive_fields_policy.gender: optional; default to unprovided unless needed for a specific experimental design
sensitive_fields_policy.health_status: do not assign diagnosis; only ordinary fatigue, stress, or routine pressure may be described
sensitive_fields_policy.family_details: use general structure only; avoid excessive private details
sensitive_fields_policy.income: use broad economic condition, not exact salary

diversity_checks: At least 4 age ranges in a 20-persona batch.
At least 6 occupation types in a 20-persona batch.
At least 5 family structures in a 20-persona batch.
No more than 25% of personas should be students or researchers.
No more than 35% of personas should have child-related life domains.
